name: 철쇄 공성관 벨카르
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent full-body enemy battle sprite for an original Korean collectible RPG, escort convoy stage 4, ruined maintenance depot. Primary request: create a wholly original IP boss, '철쇄 공성관 벨카르' / Ironchain Siege Commander Velkar. No reference to any existing manga, anime, franchise or copyrighted character; do not use previously shown images as visual references. Subject: a menacing armored siege engineer commander, fully enclosed helmet with a narrow horizontal amber visor, angular asymmetrical fortress-like pauldrons, weathered dark gunmetal and muted oxidized teal armor with restrained copper trims, short split armored waist plates and heavy articulated boots. Distinctive equipment: one forearm is an integrated heavy siege gauntlet with a short straight hexagonal cannon barrel, its bore and body on one coherent rigid axis; the other hand holds a broad rectangular riveted blast shield close to the torso. A small orange reactor core is recessed into the chest. Design should be readable and memorable with a coherent original silhouette. Style: polished premium 2D anime RPG monster art with fine painterly material rendering and clear contours, compact natural battle-sprite proportions about 4.5 heads tall, not a toy, no photorealism and no 3D plastic. Composition: one character only, full body visible including boots and every piece of equipment, stable grounded battle stance, 3/4 view facing screen-left as an enemy on the right side of a battlefield, all parts fit inside the canvas with generous 8 percent transparent margins, soles near the bottom with no floor. Small localized amber glow only; no giant aura, no detached effects. Real alpha transparent background, no scenery, no drop-shadow plate, no checkerboard drawn in the image. Both arms anatomically coherent, gauntlet mechanically attached, shield handle held naturally. No sword or katana, no flowing white robe, no eyepatch, no human hair, no lettering, no logos, no frame, no watermark. Produce a high-quality isolated game-ready sprite at 1024 or greater resolution.
source: Generated original design; no source image used as input.
processing: Both generated originals retained byte-for-byte. Final facing-right PNG resized into a 736px transparent square and padded 16px per edge to 768px WebP; alpha preserved. Existing battle renderer mirrors enemy sprites. No renderer change.

edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the provided transparent armored siege commander sprite. Make only one change: horizontally mirror the entire character so that the cannon and the helmet face toward SCREEN-RIGHT, with the shield on SCREEN-LEFT. This is a technical facing-direction version for a game engine which automatically mirrors enemy sprites; it must face right in this source so that it faces left in the actual battlefield. Preserve the exact character, armor, colors, proportions, shading, materials, equipment, silhouette, and transparent alpha background. Do not redesign, repaint, add elements or change the pose. Retain the entire character with all extremities visible. Output a transparent PNG; no backdrop, no added shadow, no text.
